svg.aria-label: The heart of the attention code, with a handwritten note beside each line: query, key and value make each letter's question, badge and note; q at k transpose matches every question with every badge; dividing by the square root of 32 shrinks the scores; masked_fill means only listen to letters before you; softmax shares out attention so every row adds up to 100 percent; attn at v collects everyone's notes in those shares.
svg.text: The meeting, in eight lines of code
From the notebook's CausalSelfAttention.forward, with the lines that split and rejoin the heads left out
